newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kampo says stops securities trading with Nomura.
newsitem.headline: Kampo says stops securities trading with Nomura.

text.p: Japan's Postal Life Insurance Bureau (Kampo) said on Wednesday that it had stopped securities trading with Nomura Securities Co Ltd after Japan's securities watchdog filed a complaint with prosecutors against the brokerage on Tuesday.

"We have stopped business with Nomura...we are not doing business with them now. Obviously, we cannot do business with a company that has had a criminal complaint filed against it," a senior official at Kampo told Reuters.
The official said Kampo has not decided when it will resume business with the brokerage firm.
The official said that Kampo's moves will include suspending bond trading business done through Nomura.

On Tuesday, the Finance Ministry had already decided to suspend Nomura from Japanese government bond auctions and bond underwriting until the implementation of administrative punishments against the brokerage proposed by the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC).
